headline: Exclusive: 10 in total! Chiayi Science Park Phase 3 kicks off; TSMC adds 5 more advanced packaging plants - Liberty Finance
summary: The National Science and Technology Council announced the Chiayi Park expansion and sought public comment, which the industry sees as the start of Phase 3. Supply chain sources say TSMC intends to build five advanced packaging plants.
why: TSMC is the world's largest contract chipmaker, and its advanced packaging capacity is central to supplying AI and high-performance chips.
